name: Husky Sundodgers (UW Men's Ultimate Frisbee)
description: UW's men's club ultimate frisbee team, described by UW Rec as a highly competitive and spirited squad that competes in regional and national tournaments. The team earned a bid to 2026 D-I college nationals at NW Regionals.
fit_reason: Competitive ultimate players who want to chase a national-level college season.

steps: Follow @sundodgers on Instagram for tryout announcements
Contact the team through UW Rec club sports

name: UW Women's Club Hockey
description: Women's club ice hockey at UW, with an ACHA travel team plus a House Team for novice players or those wanting a lighter commitment. Practices and home games are at the Kraken Community Iceplex.
meeting_schedule: Practices and home games at Kraken Community Iceplex (Northgate); times couldn't confirm
fit_reason: Women hockey players, from competitive travel skaters to novices wanting the House Team.

steps: Fill out the prospect interest form on the team site

name: University of Washington Consulting Association (UWCA)
description: UW's undergraduate consulting club, offering career skills, consulting experience, and community since 2020, including client engagements with Fortune 500 clients. Open to all majors; no prior consulting experience required.
fit_reason: Students of any major curious about consulting and real client projects.

steps: Written application: resume, transcript, three short answers
Behavioral interview with a club officer

interest_areas: Research/competitive teams (robotics, case competitions, Model UN)

name: Washington Solar Car (UW Solar Vehicle Team)
description: Student team that designs, builds, and races solar-powered cars, with mechanical, electrical, and business subteams. Its car Sakura finished 4th in the single-occupant class at the 2026 American Solar Challenge, the top American team.
fit_reason: Builders in engineering or business who want hands-on work on a real race car.

steps: Start at the Join the Team page (no experience required)
Choose a subteam: mechanical, electrical, or business

interest_areas: Research/competitive teams (robotics, case competitions, Model UN)

name: Delta Sigma Pi - Sigma Upsilon Chapter
description: UW Seattle's chapter of Delta Sigma Pi, a professional co-ed fraternity fostering the study of business, with 75+ brothers in Business, Economics, and Informatics. It recruits every Fall and Winter quarter.
fit_reason: Business, Econ, or Informatics students wanting a professional fraternity and close community.

steps: Be a full-time UW Seattle student majoring or intending Business, Economics, or Informatics with 2.5+ GPA
Attend at least 2 of the 4 recruitment events
Submit the recruitment application (linked on Linktree)

name: UW IEEE Student Branch (IEEE-HKN)
description: UW's IEEE student branch, run jointly with Eta Kappa Nu, fostering community in Electrical and Computer Engineering through networking and social events with students, faculty, and industry. It co-hosts an annual spring conference with the Bothell and Tacoma branches.
fit_reason: ECE students wanting industry networking and social events outside class.

steps: Optionally apply as an Officer in Training (no interview) via the Get Involved page
